Earlier estimates were about 3,500 years; the 2022 study (Science) raised it past 5,400.
Trunk 4.2 m wide, 28 m tall (Scientific American); chile.travel gives 4.2 m diameter and 11 m perimeter.
Only about 28 percent of the tree is alive, mostly in the roots; walking on nearby soil damages the last living parts (Barichivich).
The viewing platform sits two metres from the tree and blocks about half the rain reaching its roots; park authorities limit visits near it.
The Mapuche called the species lahuán; growth under 1 mm a year.
Guardian reported more than 10,000 tourists a year walk to the platform (Wikipedia calls the visitor number dubious).
